shortDescription: Collect facts from remote devices running A10 ACOS

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: When supplied, this argument restricts the facts collected to a given subset. Possible values for this argument include all, default, hardware, config and interfaces Specify a list of comma seperated values (without spaces) to include a larger subset.

options.name: partition
options.description: This argument is used to specify the partition name from which you want to collect respective facts.
